name: Canaanites
overview: Scripture traces the origins of the Canaanites to Canaan, a son of Ham, who was divinely cursed to be a servant to his brethren, as recorded in Genesis 9:25-27. The Canaanites became the ancestors of eleven nations, including Sidon, Heth, the Jebusites, Amorites, Girgasites, Hivites, Arkites, and Sinites, highlighting their significant presence in the land promised to Israel (Genesis 10:15-17). These verses set the stage for understanding the Canaanites' role in biblical history as inhabitants of the territory God gave to the Israelites, with implications for God's sovereign purposes and the unfolding of His redemptive plan through His covenant people.
